name: Twenty
description: An open-source CRM platform that provides highly customizable REST and GraphQL APIs, supporting custom objects and AI-driven workflows.

evidence.claim: Twenty supports both REST and GraphQL APIs for core data and metadata management.
Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE and dynamic client registration.
Twenty has an official MCP server implementation for connecting AI assistants.
Workspace-specific API documentation and an interactive playground are available in the user settings.
Twenty is open-source and can be self-hosted or used via their SaaS offering.

notes: Twenty uses a unique schema-per-tenant API model where endpoints are dynamically generated based on the workspace's custom objects. It also supports dynamic OAuth client registration (RFC 7591).
